g.text: Prometheus: how a metric gets from the app to an alert
Follow 1 -> 7. Red boxes are the lines that must match; arrows show where each value is used. Real files and real output (orders-api in demo-prod).
$ kubectl -n demo-prod exec deploy/orders-api -- curl localhost:8080/metrics
Rate = requests/s Errors = status 5xx Duration = latency histogram
2 + 3 The chart creates a Service and a ServiceMonitor
metrics.enabled: true in the env file
false = use ServiceMonitors from EVERY namespace
# Pick up ServiceMonitors / rules from every namespace, not just this Helm release.
scrapes every target every 15s, stores time series, evaluates rules
(2 targets = the 2 prod pods behind the Service, HPA min 2)
